FARM
Certified OG Since 1993.

Riverdog Farm is a 350-acre, certified organic, diversified family farm that grows vegetables, fruits, nuts, and pasture-raised chickens and pigs. We are located in the beautiful Capay Valley where rich creek-bottom soil, intense summer heat, and winter frost make exceptionally tasty fruits and vegetables.

ABOUT
What it means to join our CSA

CSA, or community-supported agriculture, is based on a mutually beneficial relationship between the farm and the people who consume our food.

Because our farm supports 50 families through year-round employment, the financial support of our CSA program is critical to our success throughout the seasons. CSA is also an integral way for the farm to personally connect to the people who eat our food. We truly thank you for your support!

FAQs

Sprouting answers to your most common questions.

Join Now
When does the season start/end?

Thanks to the support of our members, our season is able to run year-round!

How does weekly ordering & pickup work?

We'll text you each week before we harvest, and you'll have until that week's cutoff time to add extras to your order, or to notify us if you need to skip the week's share.

Your CSA box is delivered weekly to one of our many pick-up sites throughout Napa, Lake, Solano, Yolo, Sacramento, Alameda, Contra Costa counties and San Francisco. We'll text you when your order is ready to be picked up, along with designated pickup hours. Simply show up, sign your name on the sign in sheet, grab a box and be on your way! (Exact pick up addresses are given to members once subscribed).

What happens if I go on vacation/need to skip a week?

While we'd never advise skipping your veggies, we understand that life gets busy! Every week, you'll receive a text message alert when our harvest starts, with the option to “skip” to opt out of the we﻿ek's order at no charge (full season members will receive a full week's credit to use on a future order).

Can I add-on extras?

Yes! Every week, we'll text you a link to shop add-ons. Additionally, members are eligible for extra fruit through our farmshare partnership with Frog Hollow Farm, along with fresh meats and eggs from Riverdog Farm.

What am I committing to at sign up?

While members who purchase 25 or 50 shares enjoy an extra 4% in savings on their weekly boxes, you can opt for our flexible share model, which enables you to pay every 4 weeks rather than commit to the full season up-front.

Family Owned & Operated

Riverdog Farm began as a 2-acre organic vegetable farm in Napa County. Owned by Tim Mueller, Riverdog has been located in the Capay Valley since 1996. Our philosophy is that by taking care of our employees, land, and animals, we're helping to create a food system that is better for everyone.

Tim Mueller

Originally from Ohio, Tim is a man of many trades and gives the utmost care and attention to making sure that people, land, and animals are well taken care of. If you’re lucky, you’ll spot him at the Tuesday Berkeley Farmers’ market wearing his signature Riverdog t-shirt.

Contact Tim

‍

People First

We employ 50 people year-round and have multiple generations of families working at our farm. Our farm crew is like family to us, and we would love to have our family’s food be a part of your table.

Certified Organic

As one of the first organic farms to sell at the Berkeley Farmers’ markets, we have been helping to bring organic, seasonal, local food to the fore of the sustainable food movement for over 25 years.

Sustainable

Since 1990 we have used a system of compost, crop rotation, cover cropping and hedgerow planting to keep our soil healthy and to promote a healthy ecosystem around our farm. Our animals are integrated into our farming system by providing natural fertilizer for orchards and fields and are all raised on organic pasture.

Contact to Order
How do I order?

For our current list of our available wholesale items, and to place your pickup or delivery order, please contact us directly at sales@riverdogfarm.com.

What do you grow?

We grow over 80 different crops and large diversity of varieties, along with an organic pasture that provides shade for our grazing pigs, chickens, and lamb.

Can I pickup at the farm?

Yes! Wholesale orders are available for farm pickup 7 days a week, from 9am - 3pm (rain or shine!) at our farm: 7587 Road 49, Guinda CA 95637.
